system.description:
Wondrous Item, Legendary

This tube holds milky liquid with a strong alcohol smell. When found, a tube contains 1d6 + 1 ounces.

You can take a Utilize action to pour 1 or more ounces of solvent from the tube onto a surface within reach. Each ounce instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including Sovereign Glue.

Foundry Note

This item includes 7 limited uses. The Determine Ounces activity can be used to determine the number of ounces equivalent to 1d6 + 1.

The Apply Solvent activity allows you to select the number of ounces you're applying.

notes: not automated (utility): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
area: @scaling-ft square is not supported; the user picks the targets
